description: Apply a freshly printed label to a parcel, specimen tube, canister or matching part, finish applying a label already in position, or smooth down the lifted parts of a label already stuck down.
count_scope: ten task ids, nine distinct jobs: tube-label is tube-wrap's job seed for seed (same bench, tube turn, label stock and readers, and tube-wrap's checks except that the barcode-crease check reads the largest crease carried in the episode, where tube-wrap's reads the crease left at the end; tube-label also checks that the label lies over the manufacturer's label, at most 2 mm onto the bare viewing strip, and that the patient's name is at the cap end, both stated in its instruction; other accession digits and wording, set at the point of collection), so count that job once in any difficulty profile (parcel: carrier-top, gs1-case-side, cover-old-label, press-down, smooth-corner, finish-securing; specimen: tube-wrap, tube-label; part: part-id-hdpe, part-id-match); seeds vary the layout per task (label_application/variants.py SEEDS: carton pose, old-label position, laid-label position, which parts of a stuck-down label are lifted, tube roll, canister position, plate set and target, barcode payloads); part-id-steel is retired (replaced by part-id-match); smooth-corner, finish-securing and tube-label form the task ladder; every task is scored by a progress reward contract (tube-label by the take-and-apply rule)

evaluator.scope: Simulator bond/contact/trapped-air/permanent-set/stress state, label pose on the item, robot contacts and item rest, plus a zxing-cpp decode of rendered reader views at declared poses fixed by the item (fixed 1280 x 720, 24 spp; a renderer that cannot run is no verdict, not a failure). Score: every task reports a continuous progress reward beside success (1 on success, else 0.9 x progress; task.py REWARD_CONTRACTS). The mean of the checks is still reported as reward.mean_of_checks. No autonomous-solution claim.

qualification: Label physics component-qualified by assisted fixtures (peel bench, dispensing, bubbles, tube wrap) and scripted robot demonstrations.

task_set.why: Eight existing tasks spanning local repair, whole-label pressing, multi-region repair, printer-to-item application, curved and vertical surfaces, and matching a printed identity. Two entry, three medium, two hard, one hardest. All ten catalogue ids and preset defaults retain their meaning.
task_set.score_rule: 1 if success else 0.9 x continuous progress; 0 at the untouched start. Existing reward contracts are unchanged and reported as reward.contract in every evaluation.
task_set.seed_note: These are the eight exact seed-0 selections on the default dual-fr3. Seeds 0..9999 remain selectable layout variations, not separately qualified tasks.

excluded.tube-wrap: Same physical job as tube-label, which is in the set; remains registered.
excluded.cover-old-label: Omitted for diversity: carrier-top covers its application chain, tube-label and part-id-match add registration and target identification. Remains registered.

task_set.qualification: Catalogue selection only; the set adds no simulator run or render check of its own. finish-securing is kept on assisted component evidence, including side-strip repair; no complete robot route for side strips is demonstrated. The existing physics defects and evidence gaps apply (REPORT.pdf section 15).
